title: No aeroporto
context: Você chega ao aeroporto, faz o check-in e pergunta sobre o embarque.

sentences.text: Good morning. I have a flight to London.
sentences.pt: Bom dia. Tenho um voo para Londres.

sentences.text: Here is my passport and my ticket.
sentences.pt: Aqui estão meu passaporte e minha passagem.

sentences.text: Do I need to check any bags?
Yes, I would like to check this suitcase.
sentences.pt: Sim, gostaria de despachar esta mala.

sentences.text: Which gate does the flight leave from?
sentences.pt: De qual portão sai o voo?

sentences.text: Excuse me, is the flight on time?
sentences.pt: Com licença, o voo está no horário?

sentences.text: I'm sorry, I did not understand. Could you repeat that?
Thank you very much for your help.
